scenes.name: THE MISS · 错身
lines: Three forces, three running couplings. Do they ever meet at one energy?
三种力，三条跑动耦合。它们会在同一个能标相遇吗？
Run the measured values upward from the Z mass, at one loop in the Standard Model.
从 Z 质量处的实测值出发，按标准模型单圈向上跑。
They miss. Where lines one and three cross, line two sits three point six six higher.
它们错身而过：在第一、三条线的交点处，第二条线高出 3.66。

scenes.name: THE BLIND COMBINATION · 盲视组合
lines: Why so stubborn? Take line one, minus three times line two, plus two times line three.
为什么如此顽固？取第一条线，减三倍第二条，加两倍第三条。
That combination cannot see a shared coupling, a complete family, or heavy gauge vectors.
这个组合看不见共同耦合、完整家族与重规范矢量。
Light fields lift it from minus twelve point eight by only two point two, up to ten to the seventeen GeV.
轻场把它从 −12.8 一路抬到 10¹⁷ GeV，也只抬高了 2.2。

scenes.name: THE MAGNETIC SHELL · 磁球壳
lines: Could the nineteen-point magnetic shell tear multiplets apart by itself? Its nonzero neutral eigenvalues average fifteen.
十九点磁球壳能自己把多重态撕开吗？它的中性非零本征值均值是 15。
The two-step mass reading, lambda times its distance from fifteen, folds back to zero there.
两步质量读数是 λ 乘以它到 15 的距离，曲线在那里折回到零。
And the weak centre splits the fields: doublets are odd, singlets and neutral vectors are even.
弱中心再把场分成两扇：双重态为奇，单态与中性矢量为偶。

scenes.name: FOUR WALLS · 四道墙
lines: Inside this model, interval certificates raise four walls.
在这个模型里，区间证书立起四道墙。
Native generators sharing high modes: spread above two point nine three six.
原生生成元共用高模：极差大于 2.936。
Short-step face weights: strong coupling below zero point zero seven six.
短步正面权：强耦合低于 0.076。
A Planck-pinned mass unit: spread above two point zero three seven.
质量单位钉在普朗克尺度：极差大于 2.037。

scenes.name: THE MONOTONE WALL · 单调之墙
lines: The sharpest wall: all heavy fields share one never-decreasing mass rule.
最锋利的一道墙：所有重场共用同一条从不下降的质量规则。
Any such rule, at every torus phase, leaves a sharp-threshold spread above zero point seven.
任何这样的规则，在环面的每个相位上，都留下大于 0.7 的尖阈值极差。
Even one plain tower needs a log slope of at least one hundred six point seven five.
哪怕只有一座普通重塔，对数斜率也至少要 106.75。
A log-convex rule needs a span over eighty-two; Z mass to reduced Planck is under thirty-eight.
对数凸的规则需要超过 82 的跨度；而从 Z 质量到约化普朗克质量不到 38。

scenes.name: CONDITIONAL CROSSINGS · 条件交汇
lines: Two keys open a crossing, on conditions. Key one: make the even sector thirty-two times heavier.
两把钥匙能打开交汇，但各有条件。钥匙一：把偶扇区加重 32 倍。
With chord seven twenty-four as the unit, zero eleven six six one gives zero point one one eight four.
以钟弦 724 为单位，第 11661 枚零点给出 0.1184。
Key two: normalize every step by thirty-two. It reads zero point one one eight nine.
钥匙二：每一步按 32 归一化，读数 0.1189。
Both are model rules, not derivations; another matching rule sends key two to zero point one five three.
两者都是模型规则，不是推导；换一种匹配处方，钥匙二跳到 0.153。

scenes.name: THE BEDROCK · 基石
lines: Beneath it all lie two exact tools, checked by the Lean kernel.
这一切之下，是两件由 Lean 内核检验的精确工具。
Lagrange and Gram: the Cauchy-Schwarz deficit is half a sum of squares. Here both sides are fifty-four.
拉格朗日—格拉姆：柯西—施瓦茨亏量等于平方和的一半。这里两边都是 54。
On the norm five LPS shell, the matrices match, and twenty minus lambda squared stays positive.
在模方 5 的 LPS 壳层上，矩阵精确匹配，20 − λ² 始终为正。
Kernel-checked: the tools. Certified in the model: the walls. Conditional: every crossing so far.
内核检验的：工具。模型内证书的：墙。有条件的：迄今每一次交汇。

scenes.name: WALLS
lines: Omega Unification, chapter four.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第四章
